raw_answer_text:
Looking at the error messages, the issue is that the `edge` syntax requires an operator (like `->`, `<-`, `--`, or `<->`), and when labels are present, they need to be positioned within the operator using the format `-[label]->`.

The current edges are missing the directional operators. Here's the corrected document:

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 flowchart
title "BGP session reset procedure"

process checkcounters "Check interface error counters"
decision errorsfound "Errors found?"
process clearcounters "Clear interface counters"
terminator monitor "Monitor session"
terminator escalate "Escalate to operator"

edge checkcounters -> errorsfound
edge errorsfound -[yes]-> clearcounters
edge clearcounters -> monitor
edge errorsfound -[no]-> escalate
```

The key changes:
- Added `->` directional operators to each edge definition
- For labeled edges (yes/no branches), used the `-[label]->` format to position the label on the edge
- This produces a flowchart showing: check counters → decision → either clear counters and monitor (yes path) or escalate to operator (no path)
